Question: I am a boy of 24 year old i have some problem that whenever i think about sex or automaticlly some thing related to sex is came in my mind a drop or some drops of spermatic fluid (muzy)is ejected from my body.so in this case it is necessary for me to take bath or not.i m worring to much for that please help me by giving proper solution. Answer ID: 1827 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 680/676=N) Mazi ( spermatorrhea) invalidates wuzu but it does not make ghusl compulsory: لا عند مذی أو ودیّ بل الوضوء منہ ومن البول جمیعا علی الظاھر۔ قولہ 'لا عند مذی' ای لا یفرض الغسل عند خروج مذی۔ (در مع رد المحتار: 1/304، ط زکریا، دیوبند) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
